headline: Management maintained steady operational performance with minor adjustments to revenue and margin guidance across quarters.

promises.promise: Exceed 10% order inflow guidance for FY26
promises.quote: Basis the 9-month performance and the healthy prospects pipeline for the near term, we will be exceeding the 10% order inflow guidance for FY26.
promises.evidence: FY26 reported strong revenue and order momentum, and subsequent calls confirmed robust performance.

promises.promise: Retain full year revenue growth guidance of 15%
promises.quote: So we continue to retain our guidance of 15% for the full year, and we are reasonably confident that Q4, the way we have planned, the execution momentum will be at a
promises.evidence: FY26 sales grew 11.8% year-on-year to 285,875 crore, below the 15% target.

promises.promise: Projects & Manufacturing margin target is 8.5% for FY26
promises.quote: Our Projects & Manufacturing EBITDA at 7.9% for 9 months of the current year is in line with the target that we have set ourselves at 8.5% for the full year FY '26.
promises.evidence: Projects & Manufacturing portfolio margin was reported as 8.1% in Q3 and range-bound between 7.7% and 7.8% later.

promises.promise: Close the year with an NWC to revenue ratio around 10%
promises.quote: However, with stronger collection intensity and improved contractual terms, our Net Working Capital to Revenue has improved sharply to 8.2% as of December '25, and we expect to close the year with a revised target of around 10%.
promises.evidence: NWC ratio improved and remained strong around 8.2% as of December 2025.

promises.promise: Revenue guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27
promises.quote: we have given the revenue guidance of 10% to 12% for FY27, basis the fact that the first six months will be subdued
promises.evidence: FY27 has not concluded yet as the latest reported quarter is Sep 2026.

shifts.change: Lowered full-year revenue growth expectation from 15% in Q3 FY26 to 10% to 12% for FY27 announced in Q4 FY26.
Postponed finalization and announcement of Lakshya plan capex details to Q2 during the Q1 FY27 call.
